description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeModel' used within the OrangeHRM system. It models a data representation of an employee's allowed report-to relationships, including employee details such as employee number, name, ID, and termination record ID. The class uses traits and annotations for serialization and API schema documentation, and it constructs the model based on an Employee entity.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeModel
classes.description: A data transfer object that serializes Employee entity data for API responses, specifically for allowed report-to relationships, with attributes like employee number, name, and termination record ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
